name: ETGA Group Ltd
summary: ETGA Group Ltd is an Israeli enterprise primarily focused on delivering both logistical and financial services within the country. The firm provides a comprehensive range of logistics solutions, including international shipping, customs brokerage, various transportation methods, secure warehousing, as well as specialized services such as balders, drops, and e-commerce support. Complementing its logistics arm, the company also extends financing for import operations. Established in 2005, ETGA Group Ltd maintains its headquarters in Holon, Israel.
